messages:
Maya Chan: hey everyone — maya here! joining as a SWE on infra. i'm new to the SF office and brought a batch of homemade biscuits to the kitchen. i'll be there around 11:15 if anyone wants one 🍪
Noah Park: welcome, Maya! :wave: will pop by at 11:20 and bring some extra coffee ☕️
Samira K.: omg biscuits!! what kind are they? i'll stop by — coffee on me.
DevBot: Heads up: New hire orientation scheduled today at 13:00 in #all-hands. (automated reminder)
Lina R.: welcome @Maya Chan! if you like plants we have a "desk plant buddy" program — I can pair you with a low-light pothos.
Tom B.: welcome! pro tip: label your container or it becomes community property 😂
Tamika S.: hello Maya! i live nearby and can give you the quick office tour after you grab biscuits. there’s a sticky-note on the fridge for crumbs rules 😅
Maya Chan: thanks y'all! biscuits are a mix of brown sugar + oat — vegan option in the blue tupperware. i'll add a sticky with my name. excited to meet you all in person!
Noah Park: also FYI, lunchtime boardgames today in the lounge — totally optional but lots of new-joiner folks gonna be there.
Samira K.: adding the recipe here for anyone curious: `1 cup flour, 1 cup oats, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup apple sauce` — bake 12–15m. feel free to copy!
Lina R.: :heart: love a fellow baker. see you at 11:15, welcome again!
Tamika S.: welcome aboard Maya — if you need anything (badge, parking, wifi) DM me.
Maya Chan: thanks so much everyone!! will see you soon :)
